flags.statement: They included a VAT-free basic food basket for the first quarter of 2027, financed by revoking income-tax breaks for landlords letting homes at moderate rents of up to €2,300, and a freeze on university tuition fees.
flags.problem: The report lists the tuition freeze as a tax change. It was a separate education measure: the amendment capped tuition at public higher-education institutions for the 2027–2028 academic year at the previous year's levels.

flags.statement: Montenegro called the result a 'fiscal patchwork'
flags.problem: On November 20, Montenegro accused the opposition of wanting to turn the budget into a 'fiscal patchwork'; he did not describe the result as one.

flags.statement: The Air Force had recorded 186 strike drones in the night to Sunday, 72 of them jet-powered, alongside Gerbera and Parodiya-type decoys
flags.problem: The Air Force's total of 186 already included Gerbera drones and Parodiya-type decoys. They were not counted in addition to the 186.

flags.statement: In Dnipro, Russian attacks destroyed 18 trolleybuses and damaged a heating pipeline, Ukrinform reported.
flags.problem: Dnipro Mayor Borys Filatov reported 18 trolleybuses with damage to windows, doors, seats and bodies. He identified one technical trolleybus as having burned out completely, not 18 destroyed vehicles.
